Sherlock parity consumes the admitted receipted ClockRepair path; clock integration is therefore a prerequisite. Coordinate wire-version acceptance with the support-honesty migration: the historical hsmm/v3-to-v4 sequencing below must not downgrade or bypass the current checked wire contract.

Current prerequisites (replace historical dependency prose): bd-01M2TAGDJ5F0FEPC3XPWVDSWDH, bd-01M2WTGF981AY7RCN8QC42JSPT

Scheduling lane: film. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

2026-09-19 operative acceptance amendment (docs/refactor/PLAN.md):
Full public SourceView/HsmmResult signature migration follows S4c, not S2 alone; coordinate with compiler types rather than duplicating them. Preview uses checked anchored targets before this migration.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Full public SourceView/HsmmResult signature migration follows S4c, not S2 alone; coordinate with compiler types rather than duplicating them. Preview uses checked anchored targets before this migration.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 2 Typed source view.

The measured mapper builds its source view in embed-bench (TimedSourceView) from joined segment text, keeping media loci beside it. D1B's signature half moves this into the library with typed intervals; its end-to-end proofs half stays in the D1B bead. This slice does not change the hsmm wire; support honesty (hsmm/v4) follows it.

Scope:
align public types and source-view construction for timed segmentations.

Acceptance criteria:
1. SourceView no longer assumes canonical text; nodes carry checked EvidenceSupport and exact PlaybackInterval sets; HsmmResult retains exact source intervals.
2. A corpus segmentation lowered into core anchors builds a typed source view; the new path does not use TimedSourceView's joined-text surrogate.
3. No hsmm wire change: encoding an interval-bearing HsmmResult to hsmm/v3 is refused with a typed error (test), until hsmm/v4.
4. Parity: Sherlock per-unit anchors from the new path are byte-identical to the recorded all17-monofill arm (committed as a pinned anchor-list checksum); the D1A S0 pins are unchanged.
5. Construction probes for new or changed public types, including that none exposes a Mirror.ProductOf door; refusal courts for foreign bundle, axis and interval.
6. The new public types are listed in docs/api-stability.md (created here) for the Phase 4 stability table.

Gate (AGENTS.md SD2/SD6): `sbt -batch clean compileAll testAll` on the merge result, then
`sbt -batch scalafmtCheckAll scalafmtSbtCheck` as a separate run; every test task in build.sbt's
testAll alias reports bound totals (56 at 0e36a7fa, after the corpus modules were added; recount if
modules change); a named mutation witness per new guard, and each compile-time-probe mutation proved
after its own clean recompile; `cd docs-site && npm run verify:examples` when public API or examples
change; fresh-context cold review in a separate pass; the commit body states the evidence and what
it does not establish.

Size: L.
set.title: [film] Phase 2: D1B signatures -- typed source view with exact playback intervals (replaces the joined-text surrogate)
